Automatic Quote Follow-Up for Jobber (2026)

Most quotes that die just never got a second nudge. Jobber can send those nudges for you. Pair that with a receptionist that captures quote requests after hours and more of your phone calls end up as sent quotes.

← All solutions · Integrations checked Oct 15, 2026 against vendor docs

🧭 Quick decision rules

  • You're on Core→ Quote follow-ups need Connect or higher, so it's worth the upgrade if you send many quotes.
  • Leads come in by phone after hours→ Add Jobber Receptionist (its phone menu has a "Get started on an estimate" option) or Dialzara via Zapier.

🧾 What works with Jobber

Labels show how each tool connects

Jobber

Built in

Automated quote follow-ups send up to two reminders on quotes still awaiting a response, anywhere from 1 to 90 days after you send them, by the same email or text channel. Available on Connect and higher.

💵 Core $29/mo billed annually ($49 monthly), Connect $99 ($139), Grow $149 ($199) for 1 user; extra users $29/mo; card fees 2.9% + 30¢.
Source: help.getjobber.com
